description: Use when an agent compares ETH liquid staking tokens or checks one for a depeg. Input: optional token (wstETH, cbETH, rETH, weETH; comma list). Output: JSON per token exchange rate now, 7 and 30 days ago, apr7dPct and apr30dPct from rate growth, DEX market price in ETH and premiumPct vs the redemption rate. Read from Ethereum contracts and Uniswap pools, no yield API. Example: /v1/defi/staking Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

token.description: Comma list of wstETH, cbETH, rETH, weETH (default all). Unknown token → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: defi_staking
title: Ethereum liquid staking yields: wstETH, cbETH, rETH, weETH 7-day and 30-day APR with market premium or discount
